chunks: You will come to know its news/truth after a while.
ai.seo_question: What does 'after a while' mean in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a promise of delayed revelation, emphasizing that divine truth, though initially concealed or tested, will inevitably manifest to the disbelievers after a designated period ('ba'da heen'). This concept underscores the patience of God and the certainty of the Hereafter, serving as a comfort to the faithful who witness the temporary triumph of the arrogant. The 'period' is understood not merely as chronological time but as a phase of trial leading to ultimate clarity and accountability.
